clean_identity_s0.doc: Straight walk; a second person crosses between robot and target.
Target walks straight; a second person walks towards the robot and passes 0.8 m to its left.
A second person walks ahead-right of the target, then turns right while the target turns left.
As side_by_side, but both people wear the same colour, so clothing colour cannot tell them apart.
Target walks straight past a second person who stands 0.7 m to the right of the path.
